title.zh: Galaxy Digital第三季度净利润3.23亿美元，摊薄每股收益为0.66美元
title.en: Galaxy Digital第三季度净利润3.23亿美元，摊薄每股收益为0.66美元

current_state.zh: Galaxy Digital公布Q3 2026净利润3.23亿美元、调整后EBITDA 4.55亿美元，总资产164亿美元，现金/稳定币/美债49亿美元；数字资产交易量环比增12%，资管与质押规模104亿美元并与BNY达成质押合作；数据中心调整后EBITDA 6900万美元，Helios一期已向CoreWeave交付133MW；Helios二期通过35亿美元优先担保债全额融资并开工，预计2027年二季度交付；电力管线超5.7GW；原2亿美元回购完成并新授权2亿美元回购。
current_state.en: Galaxy Digital reported Q3 2026 net income of $323M and adjusted EBITDA of $455M, with $16.4B total assets and $4.9B in cash/stablecoins/Treasuries; digital-asset trading volume rose 12%, AUM/staking reached $10.4B with a BNY staking partnership; data-center adjusted EBITDA was $69M after delivering 133 MW of Helios Phase 1 to CoreWeave; Helios Phase II is fully financed via a $3.5B senior secured notes issuance and under construction, with delivery expected in Q2 2027; power pipeline exceeds 5.7 GW; the prior $200M buyback was completed and a new $200M program authorized.

updates.what_changed_zh: Galaxy Digital 公布 2026 年第三季度净利润 3.23 亿美元（摊薄每股收益 0.66 美元，调整后 0.83 美元）、调整后毛利润 5.69 亿美元和调整后 EBITDA 4.55 亿美元，同时持有 49 亿美元现金/稳定币/国债，扩大回购授权，为 Helios 二期发行 35 亿美元高级担保票据，数据中心电力储备超过 5.7 GW。
updates.what_changed_en: Galaxy Digital reported Q3 2026 net income of $323 million ($0.66 diluted EPS, $0.83 adjusted), $569 million adjusted gross profit and $455 million adjusted EBITDA, alongside $4.9 billion in cash/stablecoins/Treasuries, expanded buyback authorization, a $3.5 billion senior secured notes issuance for Helios Phase II, and data-center power reserves exceeding 5.7 GW.

updates.title_zh: 【Galaxy Digital 三季度扭亏为盈，净利润达 3.23 亿美元】
updates.title_en: 【Galaxy Digital 三季度扭亏为盈，净利润达 3.23 亿美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增了同一份Q3财报中的细节：较上季度8500万美元亏损扭亏；总资产环比增51%至164亿美元；数字资产交易量环比增12%；资管与质押规模增46%至104亿美元并宣布与纽约梅隆银行多年期质押合作；数据中心调整后EBITDA增至6900万美元，Helios一期向CoreWeave交付133MW后首个完整运营季度；Helios二期已全额融资开工，预计2027年二季度开始交付；原2亿美元回购已于10月15日完成，董事会10月26日新批准2亿美元回购额度。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details from the same Q3 report: swing from prior-quarter $85M loss; total assets up 51% to $16.4B; digital-asset trading volume up 12%; AUM/staking up 46% to $10.4B with a multi-year BNY staking partnership; data-center adjusted EBITDA rose to $69M after the first full quarter following delivery of 133 MW Helios Phase 1 to CoreWeave; Helios Phase II is fully financed and under construction with delivery expected in Q2 2027; the prior $200M buyback was completed on Oct 15 and a new $200M authorization was approved Oct 26.
updates.current_state_zh: Galaxy Digital公布Q3 2026净利润3.23亿美元、调整后EBITDA 4.55亿美元，总资产164亿美元，现金/稳定币/美债49亿美元；数字资产交易量环比增12%，资管与质押规模104亿美元并与BNY达成质押合作；数据中心调整后EBITDA 6900万美元，Helios一期已向CoreWeave交付133MW；Helios二期通过35亿美元优先担保债全额融资并开工，预计2027年二季度交付；电力管线超5.7GW；原2亿美元回购完成并新授权2亿美元回购。
updates.current_state_en: Galaxy Digital reported Q3 2026 net income of $323M and adjusted EBITDA of $455M, with $16.4B total assets and $4.9B in cash/stablecoins/Treasuries; digital-asset trading volume rose 12%, AUM/staking reached $10.4B with a BNY staking partnership; data-center adjusted EBITDA was $69M after delivering 133 MW of Helios Phase 1 to CoreWeave; Helios Phase II is fully financed via a $3.5B senior secured notes issuance and under construction, with delivery expected in Q2 2027; power pipeline exceeds 5.7 GW; the prior $200M buyback was completed and a new $200M program authorized.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Galaxy Digital reported Q3 2026 net income of $323 million versus a prior-quarter $85 million loss, with adjusted EBITDA of $455 million, total assets up 51% to $16.4 billion, digital-asset trading volume up 12%, AUM and staking up 46% to $10.4 billion alongside a multi-year BNY staking partnership, and data-center EBITDA nearly 5x higher at $69 million after delivering 133 MW of Helios Phase 1 capacity to CoreWeave, funded by a $3.5 billion senior secured note offering as its power pipeline passed 5.7 GW; the company also completed its prior $200 million buyback and authorized a new $200 million program.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Galaxy Digital reported Q3 2026 net income of $323 million versus a prior-quarter $85 million loss, with adjusted EBITDA of $455 million, total assets up 51% to $16.4 billion, digital-asset trading volume up 12%, AUM and staking up 46% to $10.4 billion alongside a multi-year BNY staking partnership, and data-center EBITDA nearly 5x higher at $69 million after delivering 133 MW of Helios Phase 1 capacity to CoreWeave, funded by a $3.5 billion senior secured note offering as its power pipeline passed 5.7 GW; the company also completed its prior $200 million buyback and authorized a new $200 million program.
